bug_report:
[12 Regression] ICE in tsubst_template_args with function template-id and local static arg
As described inhttps://bugs.linaro.org/show_bug.cgi?id=6058, this short code fragment:
==================================
template <const char *fmt, unsigned int fmt_len, typename... Args>
static void printf_impl(const char *, Args... args)
{}

struct Wrapper
{
    template <typename... Args>
    static void make(Args &&... args)
    {
        static const char fmt[] = "";
        printf_impl<fmt, 2>("");
    }
};

int main()
{
    Wrapper::make();
    return 0;
}
==================================

causes GCC to crash on trunk, since gcc-12.1 according to godbolt, and compiles OK with gcc-11.4.
It crashes for x86_64, aarch64, arm target at least.
